Weapons, tobacco, alcohol and similar: gun, katana, explosive, tnt, cigarette, poison, wine, ill, mask

Brand-logo icons that ship in the free set: android, apple, bluesky, deno, discord, docker, facebook, figma, github, gitlab, gmail, google, google-chrome, instagram, linkedin, linux, mastodon, netlify, npm, pnpm, react, slack, telegram, tiktok, twitter-bird, vercel, whatsapp, x, youtube

-sharp variants (visual duplicates of the rounded icons), -solid variants and glyph duplicates are skipped to avoid doubling the catalog; layout, alignment, arrow and letter icons are UI glyphs, not user-choosable desktop icons in this batch
Pro, Mini and Prime series (different terms) are not part of the free svg/ directory and are never imported
